pages.text: Seven mould pieces and a core make one mould. Each piece looks like the totem with its own part picked out: the Base, the Foot and Arm (two of each go in, left and right), the Torso and the Head.$(br2)A piece lasts three pours, then cracks. It takes no enchantment and no repair. The $(item)Totem Core$() becomes the forged totem's orb, so every pour needs a new one.
Mould Shells come two at a time; every piece is built from them.
